findings.evidence: shall lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window.
findings.rationale: Specifies the account lockout trigger without defining the lockout duration, unlock/recovery mechanism, or error response presented on subsequent login attempts.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' is ambiguous across three plausible antecedents (Librarian, Member, and Guarantor) and assumes a single gender.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the password-reset token expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') without measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the maximum consecutive loan renewal limit.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt.
findings.rationale: Describes the happy-path eligibility validation and receipt issuance without specifying system behavior or error handling when the item is ineligible or the barcode scan fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a maximum active hold limit without specifying the actual numeric value.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows up to 8 simultaneous physical checkouts, conflicting with SD-009 which limits Members to at most 5 physical items simultaneously.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Sets the standard print book loan period to 21 calendar days, conflicting with SD-010 which sets it to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: Unverified visitors shall be able to self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification.
findings.rationale: Permits self-registration with only an email and immediate checkout without ID verification, directly contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number before account creation.

findings.evidence: shall remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold.
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items on the pickup shelf to be held indefinitely until explicit cancellation, contradicting SD-011 which requires automatic cancellation after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag.
findings.rationale: Chained 'and/or' connectives create ambiguity about which action or combination of actions is mandatory when an item is 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or system component reviews, approves, and records fine waiver requests (and also omits handling for denied requests or waivers over $25.00 USD).

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: The non-binding qualifier 'if appropriate' leaves the condition for sending SMS due-date alerts subjective and untestable.

findings.evidence: before the due date if appropriate
findings.rationale: Fails to specify the concrete triggering lead time before the due date or the criteria under which SMS alerts must be dispatched.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the payment receipt retention duration.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines.
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019 which specifies $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance.
findings.rationale: Permits online renewal regardless of unpaid fine balances, contradicting SD-020 which blocks Members with unpaid fines exceeding $5.00 USD from renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count and enforce the 5-item borrowing limit on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Switches terminology from the established role term 'Member' (SD-001, SD-009) to 'Patron'; additionally references the 5-item borrowing limit from SD-009, which conflicts with the 8-item limit in SD-015.

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly', 'many users') without specific response-time thresholds or concurrency targets.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The non-binding qualifier 'where possible' makes query-term highlighting optional and unverifiable.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('sufficient', 'acceptable') without quantifiable accuracy percentages or latency thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without measurable throughput, file size, or degradation bounds.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references.
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds during bibliographic record deletion without defining the resulting behavior (e.g., blocking deletion or returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the full database backup schedule interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; timely manner; appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified phrases ('important', 'timely manner', 'appropriate period') without defining which actions qualify, logging latency, or retention length.

findings.evidence: retain them for an appropriate period.
findings.rationale: Specifies retaining audit records without providing a numeric retention duration or time unit.

findings.evidence: shall log event FAILOVER-01.
findings.rationale: Specifies logging an event when the primary database node is unreachable for over 10 seconds without defining the failover, recovery, or alerting action to restore service.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying security protocols/versions or concrete error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, conflicting with SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 password encryption so plaintext passwords can be decrypted, directly contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
